name: ⚽ Turbo Soccer
description: Fast arcade soccer! Dribble, charge up power shots, pass and tackle to steal the ball. Score goals, earn XP and level up 5 skills: Stamina, Strength, Agility, Dexterity and Tackle. Team Bolt vs Team Blaze - bots fill the teams so you can play right away. Golden Goal decides ties! Unlock kick trails, claim daily coins and climb the leaderboard.
